items.brief: OKX to launch tokenized Anthropic shares as pre-IPO futures trade above offering price
items.why: Tests whether tokenized pre-IPO equity markets can price assets versus Wall Street.

items.brief: Tokenized Take-Two shares draw nearly three times Nvidia's tokenized stock DEX volume
items.why: Shows tokenized equity trading volume concentrating around individual stock events.

items.brief: Singapore settles $77.5 million tokenized bill sale in local CBDC
items.why: Central bank CBDC settlement of tokenized securities expands institutional use cases.

items.brief: Ant International launches protocol for tokenized deposit and money market fund settlement
items.why: Targets real-time interoperability between tokenized cash and tokenized fund tokens.

items.brief: Singapore settles $77.5M tokenized bill sale with wholesale CBDC
items.why: MAS issues bills natively on its test network for CBDC settlement beyond trials.

items.brief: Singapore's MAS issues $77 million in tokenized bills settled via CBDC
items.why: Demonstrates native tokenized issuance and wholesale CBDC settlement by a central bank.

items.brief: CZ says tokenized Anthropic to come to BNB Chain on IPO day
items.why: Links tokenized pre-IPO equity issuance to a major public blockchain on listing day.

items.brief: Standard Chartered, StraitsX, OCBC complete tokenized deposit interoperability trial
items.why: Interoperability across platforms is framed as required for always-on tokenized deposits.

items.brief: Senators urge Treasury to ensure equal footing for stablecoin issuers under GENIUS Act
items.why: State-regulated stablecoin issuers seek a safe harbor in federal implementation.

items.brief: Ondo to launch tokenized Anthropic stock on IPO day
items.why: Adds tokenized equity tracking a Nasdaq listing from its first trading day.
